results.name: She Owns It AVL
results.description: A monthly gathering for women entrepreneurs and women-led business owners, with a featured speaker and informal conversation over drinks. Held at a Riverside Drive brewery.
results.notes: Grey: speaker-led women's entrepreneur meetup, not lead-gen. Same venue every time, recurring regulars likely. No independent site found.

results.name: AIGA Asheville
results.description: The Asheville chapter of AIGA, the professional association for design. Hosts creative hangouts, portfolio reviews and talks for designers, students and freelancers.
results.notes: Local chapter of a national professional association; peer community, not sales. Chapter page not confirmed by search.

results.name: Asheville Adventures 30's & 40's
results.description: An outdoor and wellness social group for adults in their 30s and 40s. Organizes hikes, backpacking trips, climbing lessons, yoga in the park and similar outings.
results.notes: Age-based social group with regular events through Sept 2026 per the Meetup data.

results.name: Asheville Balboa Community
results.description: A community of Balboa swing dancers that meets for a short drop-in lesson followed by a DJ-led social dance and guided practice. Beginners are welcome.
results.notes: Listing text calls itself the Asheville Balboa Community; dance community with small fee. Search found no own site.

results.name: Asheville Christian Harmony Sing
results.description: A participatory shape-note singing group that sings from the Christian Harmony songbook. No performance, beginners welcome, and books are available to borrow.
results.notes: Confirmed twice-monthly sing at First Presbyterian via event listing; contact Maddy Mullany. Own site not found.

results.name: Asheville Expat French and European Meetup Group
results.description: A small social group for French, European and expat residents of the Asheville area to meet over coffee and make friends.
results.notes: Grey: only one event (May 2026), tiny turnout. Kept because cultural-community groups qualify and not clearly a non-group.

results.name: Asheville Introverts
results.description: A social group for introverts and quiet extroverts. Hosts evening walks, craft and coffee meetups, silent book clubs and outings to local shows.
results.home_base: Beaver Lake Bird Sanctuary and various spots
results.notes: Very active Meetup (108 events). Meetup/search snippets confirm identity; has a Discord but no site.

results.name: Asheville Nature, Wisdom and Wellness Events and Retreats
results.description: Guided forest-immersion hikes, workshops and retreats in Weaverville led by one facilitator.
results.notes: Only 4 events, all facilitator-led workshops/retreats; reads as a practitioner's offerings, not a membership community.

results.name: Asheville Saturday Evening Pot Luck Dinner Group
results.description: A community potluck group that gathers for shared meals and conversation, including potlucks for artists and other creatives, in a River Arts District studio.
results.home_base: Zen Mountain Studio, River Arts District
results.notes: Seven events Jan-Apr 2026, then none. Shares host/venue with the Tao Journal group but is a different group.

results.name: Asheville Tao Journal Writing Group
results.description: A meditation and journaling group that reads classic Taoist poems and writes reflectively in response. Open to all levels.
results.home_base: Zen Mountain Studio, River Arts District
results.notes: Seven weekly sessions Jan-Feb 2026, none since. Same venue/host as the potluck group, a distinct group.

results.name: Asheville's Joy Parade
results.description: A free, sober-friendly movement club that holds dance walks and pop-up flash mobs around Asheville. Open to anyone with no dance experience needed.
results.notes: Search describes it as a weekly movement party with recurring participants; 17 events through Sept 2026.

results.name: Bakery Ride AVL
results.description: A fast-paced weekly road training ride of 45-50 miles with two pace groups. It is a drop ride that rolls out from local bike-shop meeting spots.
results.notes: Standing weekly ride with an Instagram @bakeryrideavl per listing; search found no site. Shop-hosted but run as a regulars ride.

results.name: Blue Ridge Bicycle Club
results.description: A Hendersonville nonprofit cycling club with group rides for all levels, ride leaders and sweeps. Runs weekly evening road rides and advocates for local bike infrastructure.
results.notes: 501(c)(3) club with 1,000+ members per search results; website blueridgebicycleclub.org.

results.name: CE5 Asheville
results.description: A group that gathers for meditation and group intention practices aimed at peaceful contact with extraterrestrial life. Welcomes first-timers and repeat participants.
results.notes: Monthly events through Sept 2026 via Meetup; clear shared-identity community.

results.name: CONNECT AVL
results.description: A discussion group for open conversation about society, culture and spirituality, with free book clubs at local libraries and yoga studios.
results.notes: Four free events Dec 2025-Jun 2026; no events since. Discussion/book-club format, free.

results.name: Depth & Disclosure
results.description: A small roundtable group discussing philosophy, psychology and current UFO disclosure news. Gatherings are capped at six people at a West Asheville bookish lounge.
results.notes: Grey: only one inaugural event (Jun 2026). Kept per the not-too-strict rule; low confidence.

results.name: Empire Builders
results.description: A monthly team mastermind for real estate agents run by a brokerage.
results.notes: Brokerage-run business-development programming ticketed via Eventbrite; not a public community. Reject.

results.name: Free Taco Parties
results.description: A mutual-aid style group that buys food wholesale to serve free community meals, promoting collective support and inclusive gatherings.
results.notes: Grey: one event (Dec 2025) at Village Food Truck Park, Fletcher. Kept per not-overly-strict rule; low confidence.

results.name: Happily Ever Chapter
results.description: A fantasy romance book club that meets monthly around a theme such as tear-jerkers or romantic suspense. Members share recommendations and talk tropes.
results.notes: Clear book club with themed monthly meetings through Oct 2026.

results.name: Hominy Creek Comfort Makers
results.description: A volunteer makers group that sews, knits and crochets comfort items such as hospice pillows, chemo port pillows, quilts and beanies for people in need.
results.notes: Monthly library makers group per listings; no own site found.

results.name: Jack of the Wood Thursday Bluegrass Jam
results.description: A weekly bluegrass night at a downtown pub. A host band plays first, then an open jam begins where pickers bring their instruments and join in.
results.home_base: Jack of the Wood Pub, downtown Asheville
results.notes: Grey: pub-hosted with a rotating host band, but open pickers' jam like sibling bluegrass jams. Kept; no own site.

results.name: Lake Junaluska Walk
results.description: A weekly group walk around Lake Junaluska for fresh air, gentle movement and lake views. Tied to The Pollinators Foundation.
results.notes: Grey: listed through the visitor center with thin detail; standing weekly walk. Kept, low confidence.

results.name: Living Wage Coalition of Transylvania County
results.description: An advocacy coalition, part of Just Economics, working to promote living wages in Brevard and Transylvania County. Meets by Zoom and oversees living wage employer certification.
results.notes: Confirmed on justeconomicswnc.org; meets 1st Thursday 10am-noon. Transylvania County is in area.

results.name: Meet the Geeks
results.description: A casual meetup for Asheville's tech community with sponsored food and time to mingle over drinks at local breweries.
results.notes: Tech community social with a stable organizer and sponsors; networking framing but peer community, not lead-gen.

results.name: Misfit Improv and Acting School
results.description: An improv comedy school and show company offering paid classes and ticketed shows in Asheville.
results.notes: Mostly paid classes and ticketed shows via Crowdwork; a business. Free jams exist but are minor. Joyride Improv is separate.

results.name: Nicotine Anonymous
results.description: A 12-step fellowship for people who want to quit nicotine in any form and stay quit. The only requirement is a desire to quit. Meets in person and online.
results.notes: Also listed as Asheville Quits; meets at the 12-Step Recovery Club on Kenilworth Knolls. No confirmed chapter URL.

results.name: Open Heart Meditation Community
results.description: A free weekly community gathering with guided heart-opening relaxation, often followed by a relaxing music jam.
results.notes: Description says weekly Thursdays at 6pm; last events Dec 2025.

results.name: Positively Asheville
results.description: A monthly meet-and-greet where locals connect, share ideas and collaborate on community and business projects.
results.notes: Grey: hosted at a martial arts studio, possibly the studio's own event. Recurring collaboration meetup; kept, low confidence.

results.name: Restoring Western North Carolina through Art & Community
results.description: A community group formed after Hurricane Helene to rebuild connection through art and social outings, such as a downtown holiday scavenger hunt.
results.notes: Grey: two events in Dec 2025, none since. Kept per not-overly-strict rule; low confidence. Helene purpose is inferred from the name.

results.name: Sex Addicts Anonymous
results.description: A confidential 12-step fellowship for people seeking recovery from addictive sexual behavior. Meets weekly in local churches.
results.notes: Weekly Monday 7:30pm at First Congregational UCC per regional meeting list; the Chunns Cove listing is likely the same meeting.

results.name: Social Seniors
results.description: A drop-in social gathering for older adults to connect with peers through games and activities at a city community center.
results.notes: 198 listings; a standing seniors' program at a city center with regular attendees. No own site found.

results.name: Stitches of Love
results.description: A small group of stitchers, crocheters and quilters who make handmade items to donate to local charities. All skill levels are welcome to join.
results.notes: Listing describes a small group of dedicated stitchers donating to charities; no own site found.

results.name: Terra X
results.description: A live-action role-playing (larp) community that runs blaster-based games and a yearly festival, and recruits players, refs and organizers.
results.notes: One brewery planning meetup (Mar 2026) for the Terra X larp and Gear Up Festival. Hobby community; sparse data.

results.name: The Triangle Discover Group
results.description: A beginner Christianity discussion series held in Cary.
results.notes: Only event is in Cary (Triangle), outside Western NC.

results.name: Urban Dharma
results.description: A West Asheville Buddhist temple and sangha offering daily meditation, open sangha gatherings and Sunday smoke-cleansing. Free and open to all, with donations welcomed.
results.home_base: Urban Dharma, Haywood Rd, West Asheville
results.notes: Own site udharmanc.org lists regular events; temple with sangha, generosity-based. Recovery Dharma is tracked separately.

results.name: Weekend Hiking and Outdoor Adventure (WHOA)
results.description: A hiking group that leads weekend outings on trails around Asheville. Hikers go at their own pace and leashed dogs are welcome.
results.notes: Only one upcoming Meetup event in data, but a clear hiking club identity. No site found.

results.name: WNC Fine Dining Club
results.description: A social dining group that meets at Asheville restaurants, often during Restaurant Week, to share a meal and meet new people.
results.notes: Recurring dinner club through Aug 2026 with group reservations; members pay for own meals.

results.name: Women Talking
results.description: A conversation meetup for genuine connection, welcoming women and men. Members share, listen and meet new people with no dating pressure.
results.home_base: East Asheville Library and Haywood Rd
results.notes: New group with two events in Sept 2026; social conversation group. Keep per not-overly-strict rule.
